newsitem.title: USA: Bonal says expenses caused Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Bonal says expenses caused Q3 loss.

text.p: Bonal International Inc said Tuesday higher marketing expenses contributed to a loss in the third quarter ended December 31 versus a profit one year ago.
Bonal reported a loss of $36,428 in the period, or $0.11 a share, compared with net income of $28,775, or $0.03 a share in the corresponding period last fiscal year.
Revenues fell to $424,134 from $485,987, Bonal said.
The company said it doubled its internal sales force since the third quarter of fiscal 1996 and changed its sales mix.
Bonal provides stress relief technology and equipment.
